privateRoom.activeDesc: The seller started the private room. Anyone can watch; only invited bidders can place bids. The room ends 60 seconds after the last bid.
privateRoom.createdDesc: Invitees have 15 minutes to accept. The auction will start automatically after the acceptance window.
privateRoom.availableDescSeller: Create your private room and invite 2–5 bidders to continue. You received an email with a link to get started.
privateRoom.availableDescBuyer: The seller can create a private room and invite some bidders to continue. You'll be notified if you're invited.
privateRoom.closedNoWinner: The auction was closed because no invited bidders accepted the invitation within 15 minutes. There is no winner.

ended.noBidsBuyer: This auction closed with no bids.
ended.auctionEndedWinner: Auction ended. A winner has been selected.

actions.auctionHasEndedNoBids: This auction has ended with no bids.
actions.auctionHasEndedWinner: This auction has ended. A winner has been selected.
actions.sellerHas24hOffer: Seller has 24h to accept an offer
actions.sellerHas24hWinner: Seller has 24h to choose a winner
